Name: Asriel, Son of Gilead
Summary: Asriel, son of Gilead, founded a clan of Manasseh east of the Jordan.
KeyStory: Asriel is named among the sons of Gilead in the second census of Israel.
RelatedPeople: Gilead, Son of Machir; Machir, Son of Manasseh
LifeLesson: Even a single mention means God did not overlook him.
